Privacy Notice & Data Processing Consent
By submitting your application and uploading your resume/CV, you acknowledge and agree that Xsolla will process your personal information (including but not limited to your name, contact details, work experience, and educational background) for the purpose of recruitment, candidate evaluation, and internal record-keeping.

In accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (PIPL):
Purpose Limitation: Your data will only be used for current and future recruitment considerations within Xsolla.
Sensitivity: We will handle your personal information with a high duty of care.
Your Rights: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, and to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

If your application proceeds past the final interview stage, we may conduct a background check, subject to applicable laws and regulations, only after obtaining your separate written consent. Any such check will be strictly limited to information directly relevant to the employment relationship (e.g., educational background, employment history) and will comply fully with the PIPL. Your personal information will be used solely for recruitment and human resource management purposes, and we will implement rigorous security measures to protect your data.

Xsolla takes your privacy rights seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with Chinese data protection laws and will not sell, unlawfully provide, or disclose any personal data received during the hiring process without your explicit authorization. As a data processor, we uphold our obligations to safeguard your personal data and respect your privacy.

For any inquiries related to data privacy, please contact: careers@xsolla.com

Explore more opportunities at: https://xsolla.com/careers

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators.
Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is self-motivated, product-minded, and technically rigorous to join our Storefront Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to build a high-quality, white-label Android game store from the ground up, tackling complex challenges in large-game distribution, download management, and multi-tenant theming.
 
Strong Kotlin and modern Android development skills are essential, along with experience in native Android development, particularly with large-file downloaders, app stores, or content distribution systems. The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, design, backend, and QA) and drive technical decisions will be key to your success in this role.

If you’re passionate about creating high-performance, feature-rich consumer-facing applications and love solving the unique technical challenges of distributing and updating large-scale Android games, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Design, build, and maintain the Android client for the game store, using Kotlin + Jetpack Compose to deliver a modern, high-performance UI.

  • Implement core features: game browsing, categories, search and filtering, game detail pages, user accounts, game library, ratings and reviews.

  • Design and implement the game download, install, and update management module (resumable downloads, guided/silent installation, signature verification, version management).

  • Implement white-label theming and multi-channel build capabilities (via Gradle product flavors and/or runtime theme configuration) to support per-partner branding.

  • Optimize app performance (e.g. startup time), stability (e.g. crash rate), binary size, and memory usage.

  • Collaborate closely with product owner, designer, backend dev, and QA; contribute to technical design and code reviews.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; enforce coding standards and participate in peer code reviews.

  • Game industry experience required
  • On-site position only (remote work not available)

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of native Android development experience.

  • Strong command of Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow for asynchronous programming (or mastery of Java and its equivalents).

  • Proficient with Jetpack Compose for declarative UI development (traditional View/XML experience is a plus).

  • Familiar with Android Jetpack components (ViewModel, Lifecycle, Room, Navigation, Hilt) and MVVM/MVI architecture.

  • Familiar with common libraries: networking (Retrofit/OkHttp), image loading (Coil/Glide), and local storage.

  • Familiar with the Gradle build system, including white-label / multi-tenant / multi-flavor builds, signing, and version management.

  • Solid understanding of Android’s installation mechanisms, permission model, and behavioral changes across OS versions.

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: coding standards, unit testing, and version control (GitLab/GitHub).

  • Proficiency with AI coding tools to boost development productivity.

• Understanding of the Chinese gaming industry, game app characteristics, and player needs.

  • Experience in game development, publishing, or operations on major Chinese gaming platforms.

  • Familiarity with the Android package structure exported by game engines such as Unity / Unreal (APK + OBB expansion files, large asset bundles).

  • Experience integrating game SDKs (account login, in-app purchases, ad monetization, analytics, real-name verification).

    • Note: Less experienced candidates could be considered as middle-level developers.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is systems-minded, detail-oriented, and passionate about building scalable infrastructure to join our Platform Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to design and own the server-side architecture of a white-label game distribution platform, tackling challenges in multi-tenancy, large-file delivery, and high-concurrency systems.

Strong command of GoLang and solid experience in microservices and distributed systems are essential, along with experience in building backend services for content distribution, app stores, or gaming platforms. The ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive technical decisions on performance, security, and observability will be key to your success in this role.
If you’re passionate about building robust, high-performance backend systems that power game distribution at scale and love solving complex infrastructure problems in the gaming ecosystem, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Design, build, and maintain the backend services for the game distribution platform, with a highly available and scalable server-side architecture

  • Design and implement a multi-tenant architecture supporting data isolation

  • Design and implement the storage and delivery solution for large game files (object storage / CDN, signed download URLs, resumable downloads, version management)

  • Build backend APIs and permission systems for the operations admin panel and publisher portal

  • Design and deliver the search solution (e.g., Elasticsearch) to power full-text search and filtering of games

  • Ensure system performance, concurrency, security, and observability (monitoring, logging, alerting)

  • Game industry experience required
  • On-site position only (remote work not available)

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong command of GoLang

  • Proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, etc.)

  • Solid RESTful API design skills; familiar with microservice architecture

  • Familiar with relational database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) design and optimization; knowledge of NoSQL (Redis, etc.)

  • Familiar with message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), caching, and other middleware

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: coding standards, unit testing, Git, CI/CD

• Understanding of the Chinese gaming industry and experience in Chinese game building, publishing, or operation on major Chinese gaming platforms

  • Experience in backend development for games or game platforms

  • Familiarity with server-side integration of game SDKs (accounts, in-app purchases, real-name verification)

  • Familiarity with in-app purchase (IAP), virtual goods, and order management

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS / white-label platform architecture

  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch

  • Experience designing and optimizing high-concurrency, high-traffic systems

  • Experience with app stores or content/game distribution platforms

  • Knowledge of object storage and CDN, with experience in or awareness of large-file / high-concurrency delivery

    • Note: Less experienced candidate could be considered as middle-level developer.
